name: Entity Reference Deck Moderation
description: Content Moderation integration: CM-aware moderation style and related deck surfaces.
project_description: Feature submodule of Entity Reference Deck. Provides EntityReferenceDeckContentModerationStyle, a Content Moderation-aware implementation of the deck's moderation-style resolver, so reference cards tint and label themselves by workflow state (draft / has unpublished edits / new). It integrates with the core 'moderation' card action's status tag. Requires the core Content Moderation and Workflows modules.
